instruction: Candid outdoor full shot from a high angle of a couple walking down a rocky path next to a marble wall. On the left, the woman in the white sweater and beige hat (R1) walks with her right hand resting on the marble wall, looking down. On the right, the man in the brown sweater and dark hat (R2) walks slightly ahead, holding her hand. Soft natural daylight illuminates the rocky path, contrasting the cool blue-gray marble wall with the warm colors of their sweaters.
